newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev softer vs mark,down against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev softer vs mark,down against dollar.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev opened at 996-998 per mark, a touch softer from 996-997 at Friday's close as local traders tested a wider spread amid a relatively low foreign currency demand, traders said.
* Large local end buyers of foreign currency like fuel and energy importers have not been sighted on the market yet.
* The lev fell to 1,837-1,841 to the dollar from Friday's close at 1,830-1,834 in line with weakening mark/dollar on global markets.
